reason: Use Tier 2: replace dot-product scoring with a learned-temperature cosine scoring head. Bidirectional masked reconstruction improved macro HR@10 to 0.5800, while the local convolution adapter reduced it to 0.5725, favoring an isolated change to scoring rather than additional context modules. Unconstrained embedding norms may distort rankings for sparse Amazon items; this is a testable hypothesis, not an established explanation for the plateau.

Use this identical head for positive logits, sampled-negative logits, and predict so training and inference optimize the same representation.
